en.headline: New World Development suspends trading pending inside information
en.dek: Shares and guaranteed bonds halted from 9 am Friday after the company requested suspension for an announcement on certain inside information; last traded at HK$4.87.
body: New World Development Company Limited requested a trading halt on its shares and related debt securities from 9:00 am on Friday, 13 November 2026, pending the release of an announcement on certain inside information, according to a statement filed with the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong.

The halt covers stock code 0017 and multiple bonds issued by the company's wholly-owned subsidiaries and guaranteed by New World Development. The company said trading would resume once the announcement is published. Shares last traded at HK$4.87 before the suspension.

The developer has faced elevated scrutiny over its debt levels following recent financial results. The Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing confirmed the halt in an exchange notice, noting that structured products linked to the company were also suspended.
Investors are awaiting details of the inside information. No further specifics were available from the company at the time of the halt.

zh.headline: 新世界發展今早停牌 待公布內幕消息
zh.dek: 股份及多隻擔保債券由周五上午9時起暫停交易，公司要求停牌以待發出若干內幕消息公告；停牌前報4.87元。
body: 新世界發展有限公司根據向香港聯合交易所提交的公告，要求由2026年11月13日星期五上午9時起暫停其股份及相關債務證券交易，以待公司發出有關若干內幕消息的公告。
停牌涵蓋股份代號0017，以及由公司全資附屬公司發行並由新世界發展擔保的多隻債券。公司表示公告刊發後將恢復交易。股份停牌前報4.87元。
該發展商近期業績公布後，債務水平備受市場關注。香港交易所在通告中確認停牌，相關結構性產品亦一併暫停交易。
投資者正等待內幕消息詳情。停牌時公司未提供進一步具體資料。
